address: Winslade Park Avenue, Manor Drive, Clyst St Mary, EX15 1FY, United Kingdom
bio: A beautifully restored, early 19C manor house with 86 acres of grounds provides the lovely setting, while the food is ably taken care of by an experienced and very capable kitchen team. Local ingredients are used extensively in various menus that offer something for everyone and allow for plenty of flexibility. Desserts are a particular highlight. The terrace overlooks the gardens and cricket field....
